acceptance.correctness: Every candidate agrees with full on each sequence and deliberately invalid control; expected verdicts asserted. Missing/corrupt optimization evidence falls back to full, never grants acceptance. Current root cannot advance on rejection/interruption. Historical direct lookup stays zero ancestry.
acceptance.performance: Material win requires >=10% median paired cumulative saving versus freshly reproduced full, positive savings in every repetition of both high-medium and high-long; all initial and ongoing evidence maintenance included. Other conditions reported without universal adoption.
acceptance.stop: If neither packed representation passes material-win criterion, provisionally default to full validation for these cheap-rule workloads and close receipt optimisation pending new evidence; no further receipt representation proposed.

hypotheses.H1: Per-receipt object overhead dominates and packing reduces cumulative cost.
hypotheses.H2: Shared group directories improve high-reuse economics.
hypotheses.H3: Pack decoding, integrity and maintenance erase reduced object counts.
hypotheses.H4: Unchanged mandatory population checks impose the remaining floor.
hypotheses.H5: Outcome depends on update locality, rules, granularity or retention.

mechanism.directory: Flat candidate repeats slot-to-pack membership and old component membership. Shared candidate references one immutable group pack per family/group and derives prior membership from independently hashed publication. Both roots are independently caller-pinned verifier outputs, not candidate-selected authority.
mechanism.measured: Individual lookup adds one receipt object per eligible component; four root maps duplicate population metadata each publication. Initial receipt issuance is expensive. Prior timings isolate validation and maintenance, not a causal disk/parse split.
mechanism.nonReducible: Hash every current component, always check publication completeness and qualifier, rerun affected/contextual edges, authenticate exact rule/component/guarantee, retain all historical evidence.
mechanism.packing: Group sorted family slots by numeric partition // K. Each slot contains an addressable local receipt with its own canonical digest, outgoing dependencies and reverse sources. Partial change rewrites whole immutable group. No pack ancestry.
mechanism.reducible: Coalesce local receipt and anchored adjacency metadata into immutable family-local groups; share unchanged groups. Replace slot-expanded directory with group-to-pack membership.

timing: Three independent stores. Rotate four candidate order by step+repetition; reset request caches. Common fixture/manifest construction and atomic publication cost separated and apply equally. Retain fsync and current hash guards. OS cache uncontrolled; same-process warm and separate-process historical controls. RSS UNKNOWN, tracemalloc peak only labelled Python allocations.
